arguments.message: Riley planning proposal: to avoid overlap penalties, I suggest a sparse path with one meeting per time region and full attendance on strict m014 [12,13). Tentative Riley plan: m010 [0,2), m006 [2,4) or [1,5) if others strongly prefer, m001 [4,6), then choose ONE of {m009 [5,8), m008 [5,9), m002 [6,10), m005 [7,10), m007 [7,11), m012 [7,10), m013 [8,12), m011 [10,12), m004 [11,12)} to create overlap, but not multiple overlapping meetings. My preference is a coordinated chain: m010 [0,2), m006 [1,5), m001 [4,6), m002 [6,10), m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13). If others can align on those, seems high-value and conflict-free except slot 4 if m006 full; alternatively m006 [1,4) to avoid overlap with m001. Please share likely commitments, especially for m002/m011/m014.

Quinn planning proposal: I support a sparse non-overlapping path to maximize soft overlaps without self-penalties. My current preferred chain is m010 [0,2), then ONE early study/art block chosen to avoid conflict—lean m003 [2,4) or m006 [1,4), then m001 [4,6), then m002 [6,10), then m011 [10,12), m014 [12,13). I will likely skip overlapping alternatives m008/m009/m005/m007/m012/m013 unless strong coordination emerges around a different common path. If others can align on m010, m001, m002, m011, and full m014, that seems strong. Please indicate whether you prefer m003 or m006 in [1,4).

Quinn to Jordan: for our shared meetings, I’m leaning toward a conflict-free path rather than stacking overlaps. Tentative: m010 [0,2), maybe m003 [2,4) with you (instead of m015), then skip to m002 [6,10)? though that one doesn't include you; later m011 [10,12) and strict m014 [12,13). For our shared options in [7,12), I currently prefer not to attend m008/m012/m013 if we can get enough coordination on m011+m014. Let me know if you want to coordinate on m003 [2,4) or another Jordan-shared meeting.

Jordan planning: I also favor a sparse, non-overlapping chain. For my meetings, tentative path is m010 [0,2), m003 [2,4), then choose ONE of m015 [4,6) or m016 [4,8) but likely m015 [4,6) to avoid long conflicts, then later likely m011 [10,12) and full strict m014 [12,13). I am inclined to skip the dense overlapping cluster m008/m009/m007/m012/m013 unless the group strongly converges elsewhere. If others want Jordan overlap, best bets seem m010, m003, m015, m011, m014. Please signal preferences, especially Reese/Taylor on m015 and everyone on m011/m014.

So our best shared path looks like m010, m003, m015, m011, m014, with me likely skipping m008/m012/m013 unless coordination shifts.

Reese planning: I agree with the sparse non-overlapping strategy. For my current tentative path, I prefer m010 [0,2), then m003 [2,4) rather than full m006 to avoid conflict with m001, then m001 [4,6), then m002 [6,10), then m011 [10,12), and full strict m014 [12,13). I would likely skip m015/m016/m008/m009/m005/m007/m012/m013 unless coordination shifts. This aligns well with Quinn/Riley on m010, m001, m002, m011, m014, and gives Jordan overlap on m003. If others strongly prefer m006 instead of m003 for the early block, I can reconsider, but my current preference is m003 [2,4). (phase=planning, iter=1)

This should overlap well with Quinn/Reese/Jordan on m003 and with most of group on m010/m001/m011/m014. If anyone especially wants Avery on a late soft meeting instead of m011, let me know.
